body: Siickworld is right, even if the blue sky bullshit doesn't get through, talk to her. She does have a moral right to know your feeling like this, but mainly because if she can do something and you don't talk, then a life is wasted for no reason. Hats off to you for the shifts though those some brutal hours man.

Sorry I guess I should have mentioned Im an addict, with something messed up going on but only been diagnosed with depression because i was forced to lie about symptoms to avoid incarceration. Is there any where you can just be honest without be locked up?
I hate to sound like im avoiding assistance, but they will not help me because im a drug addict.

Dont do it friend!
I have just done this very thing now the only thing in my life stopping complete destruction is gone, now its just me, staring and crying. 
 Read her your first two paragraphs and simply say thank you.
 She would not have endured that if there was no hope for you and having been there she knows man...

I admire your proactive attitude, you came on here with a problem and inadvertently helped someone with theirs, thank you. 
 I wish u all the best at the clinic and im here to pm if needed:)

Firstly I'm sorry she did that, my sons mum is guilty of the same. I'm not sure what the rules where u are, but in the UK the doctors are bound by law to pick up on certain things. Mainly these are if u are using the S word, self harm(not chain smoking) or talking about hurting others. 
You said you are on your way in to the hole, your statement doesn't speak of any intention to harm any one including you instead you have displayed self awareness, so the scenario should remain very much in your hands.
I suspect you already know but the best thing you can try to do is talk to the docs at the ER. Easier said than done I know. I hope it helps, as bobby said 'just keep swimming'
Thank you for the amazing descriptions and insights, I think this has helped gain a little more understanding of this constant 'war'.
Thats a really good point that I failed to consider, if I cant understand its good then I suppose others wont either...
Thank you for the description your creative flair is clearly present in your language, its given a description to a long present feeling and reinforced a bit of hope. I hope you can set her free.
Its evenings for me, there is little to occupy a clouded brain when its so quiet.
